articles.summary: “Travelers Across America” initiative brings partners together to focus on community resilience at the historic Oliver Kelley Farm The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV ) and the National Trust for Historic Preservation today celebrated the fourth event of their national preservation and community resilience campaign, Travelers Across America , in Elk River, Minnesota. The initiative, which focuses on restoring landmarks and strengthening community resilience in honor of America’s 250th, host
articles.title: Travelers and National Trust for Historic Preservation Bring National Resilience Campaign to Minnesota
